activity.note: No verified equivalent in the selected public releases; do not invent a value.

raw.label: Pulse / endeks / dönem okuması ve zamanı
raw.note: Several incompatible signal semantics. HSB/Aalborg upstream processing retained. No common volume conversion by guess.

device.label: Varsa heartbeat / bağlantı / arıza durumu
device.note: errorFlags belongs to the associated device family; not evidence of water-meter heartbeat or transport quality.

configuration.label: Litre/pulse ve konfigürasyon geçerliliği
configuration.note: Source resolution needs units and metadata reconciliation. No validity-dated institutional litre/pulse configuration supplied.

scope.label: Tek hane / ortak / bilinmeyen ölçüm kapsamı
scope.note: Private/shared/nonresidential and cold/hot/HVAC streams require separate scope. No water+hotWater automatic sum.

area.label: Bölge ve üst bölge kodu
area.note: Istanbul district identity and Spanish site assets are separate namespaces; none are Kocaeli household locations.

meter_model.label: Sayaç teknolojisi ve model kodu
meter_model.note: Foreign hardware references; no Manas model or calibrated error curve inferred.

monthly.label: Kodlanmış aboneliğin dönem tüketimi
monthly.note: No verified equivalent in the selected public releases; do not invent a value.

regional.label: Bağımsız bölgesel tüketim ve kapsamı
regional.note: Annual 2000-2022 plus monthly 2023. Preserve conflicting overlapping 2015 releases and publisher totals separately. Not ISU regional demand.

temperature.label: Sıcaklık
temperature.note: Celsius NASA and Fahrenheit Illinois have different geography/clock; only metadata-backed conversions allowed.

rain.label: Yağış
rain.note: Selected city reference grid, mm/day, UTC. Reanalysis context, not station truth or issuance-time forecast.

drought.label: Varsa kuraklık indeksi
drought.note: No verified equivalent in the selected public releases; do not invent a value.

weather_issued.label: Hava yayım / erişim zamanı kontrolü
weather_issued.note: No verified equivalent in the selected public releases; do not invent a value.

curve.label: Debiye göre işaretli hata eğrisi
curve.note: No verified equivalent in the selected public releases; do not invent a value.

events.label: Tarihli olay ve kanıt türü
events.note: End-use labels with source-specific provenance. No verified leak/guest/vacancy/renovation household-event truth.

liters.label: Türetilen saatlik / günlük litre
liters.note: Existing Aalborg retrospective processed litres work. New sources are retained as delivered until semantic gates pass.

coverage.label: Türetilen kapsama / kalite durumu
coverage.note: Temporal completeness can be measured; absence is not proof of zero use or provider outage.

shape.label: Saatlere göre tüketim payları
shape.note: Do not pool fixture/event and whole-house scopes.

daily_history.label: Günlük gecikmeler ve hareketli özetler
daily_history.note: Existing Aalborg baseline available; external cohort adapters still pending.

intraday_history.label: Tahmin saatine kadar gün içi tüketim
intraday_history.note: Actual historical publication/arrival times absent; online availability is an explicit research assumption.

hourly_history.label: Saatlik gecikmeler ve hareketli özetler
hourly_history.note: Hour bucket boundaries must follow source clock and volume conservation.

calendar.label: Saat / haftanın günü / ay
calendar.note: Do not apply Europe/Istanbul to foreign cohorts automatically.

anomaly_features.label: Pencere hacmi / gece payı / değişim
anomaly_features.note: Candidate features are not evidence of a confirmed leak.

flow_profile.label: Çözünürlük uygunsa debi–hacim dağılımı
flow_profile.note: Relative fixture traces and event averages are available; unit, resolution and population differences remain explicit.

anomaly_output.label: Anomali adayı, skor ve zaman aralığı
anomaly_output.note: No verified equivalent in the selected public releases; do not invent a value.
